[LTIM.2.5.4] When a rule carries both a time-dependent gate and a `cooldown`
([LCDB.3.2.1]), the maturity gate ([LTIM.2.5])
and the rate gate compose by conjunction: the rule fires when the condition first
holds **and** the rate window permits. The rate gate remains RHS-level and
stateful; the maturity gate is a stateless pre-fire test.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__fire_at
idris.note: The firing at a selection, with calls: mark, then the gated RHS with the rule's sites.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__fire_called
idris.note: The gated firing with calls: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's selection and mark, then the gated RHS with calls.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_at_projects
idris.note: With no rule sited the firing at a selection projects to Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's at the same selection, over every selection.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_fire_projects
idris.note: With no rule sited the called firing projects to the timed firing on the timed half of the state, over every state.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_outcome
idris.note: WITH NO SITE THE GATED RHS IS Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's: the same gate, verdict, net, stamps and trackers, the call trackers untouched and no call issued.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__no_site_run_if
idris.note: With no site, the RHS under a verdict is Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's, over every verdict.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__rhs_gated_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls gated by the rule's cooldown: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's gate, then the RHS with calls under its verdict.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__run_if_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls under the rule's verdict: admitted, the actions and the sites run from position 0; refused, nothing runs and no call is issued.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__rhs_gated_called_inv
idris.note: The gated RHS with calls keeps the invariant: admitted, the RHS with calls; refused, the marked net stands.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__no_timed_rule_is_the_gated_pump
idris.note: With no maturity gate the conjunction is the rate gate alone: the timed pump is the gated pump.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__allowed_is_the_stamped_firing
idris.note: AN ADMITTED FIRING IS THE STAMPED FIRING: with the gate's verdict `true` on the fired match's key at the clock, the firing's net and stamps are what the stamped RHS leaves on the marked net, and the trackers gain the key at the clock. Over every program, state, selection, stamp table and tracker table.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__drop
idris.note: A verdict with its stamps dropped: what Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's RHS returns, by projections.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_at
idris.note: THE FIRING AT A SELECTION, stamped: mark the activation fired, then the gated stamped RHS.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_at_projects
idris.note: THE FIRING AT A SELECTION PROJECTS to Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's firing at the same selection, over every selection.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_timed
idris.note: THE GATED FIRING WITH STAMPS: Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's selection and mark, then the gated stamped RHS. The selection is of the re-timed chains: 'the rule fires when the condition first holds and the rate window permits'.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_timed_just
idris.note: A timed firing that names a firing: the gated firing on the projected state names the same firing, with the state projected.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_timed_nothing
idris.note: A timed firing that resolves to nothing: so does the gated firing on the projected state.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__fire_timed_projects
idris.note: THE TIMED FIRING PROJECTS TO THE GATED FIRING: on every timed state, dropping the stamps and the wall from what it fires gives Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's firing on the projected state. The rate gate's theorems (window, boundary, key independence, one stamp) hold of this firing through it.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__label
idris.note: A firing named: the ordinal, the fired facts and the verdict, with the timed state after it, the wall sample kept. By projections.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__proj_firing
idris.note: A named firing with its state projected.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__rhs_gated
idris.note: THE STAMPED RHS GATED: a rule with no cooldown runs its actions; otherwise Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's gate decides at the net's clock with the key of the fired match, once, and the stamped RHS runs on its `true`. 'The maturity gate and the rate gate compose by conjunction': the maturity gate is before this and stateless -- the activation this fires exists only because the sample admitted it -- and the rate gate is RHS-level and stateful, in the trackers.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__rhs_gated_drops
idris.note: THE STAMPED RHS GATED, DROPPED, IS Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's GATED RHS: the same gate, the same verdict, the same net and trackers, over every cooldown, program, state and table.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__run_if
idris.note: THE STAMPED RHS UNDER A VERDICT: admitted, the actions run and stamp on the marked net; refused, the marked net and the stamps stand; the trackers are the verdict's. The rate half of the clause's conjunction, applied.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__run_if_drops
idris.note: THE STAMPED RHS UNDER A VERDICT, DROPPED, IS Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's, over every verdict, program, net and stamp table.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__second_maturity_is_gated
idris.note: UNDER A COOLDOWN A SECOND MATURITY INSIDE THE WINDOW IS GATED, AND THE MATCH DOES NOT REFIRE PAST IT: the on-delay under `cooldown 60`; the Motion asserted at 0 matures at 2 and acts; retracted and asserted again at 10, a new match, it matures at 12 inside the minute, fires and is gated; at 70 the match persists and nothing fires -- logical/LTIM.2.4.2_cooldown_still_gates_across_ticks's shape. The conjunction: the condition first holds AND the rate window permits. Executed: `[[], [(0, True)], [], [(0, False)], []]`.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__suppressed_runs_no_action
idris.note: A REFUSED FIRING RUNS NO ACTION AND STAMPS NOTHING: with the verdict `false`, the firing's net is the marked net, the stamps and the trackers are the ones before. Over every program, state, selection, stamp table and tracker table.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__step_fires_timed
idris.note: A follow-up with no cooldown: the maturity gate alone decides, and the rate gate admits by construction.
